verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents the shape of the transcription output. It does not mention JSON responses, per-word or per-segment confidence scores, or utterance/segment objects. Diarization (speaker separation) and Agent STT's 'turn-based transcription' are related features, but neither shows structured JSON with confidence values, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, results come back as structured JSON with utterances or segments and confidence values, not just a text blob
